chaos.meaning: Wild, impetuous, unruly creative force that wants to break out; not synonymous with disorder or technical damage
chaos.direction: Give related events a musical trajectory without ironing out their differences. Preserve unexpected interactions, local asymmetry and creative plurality.
chaos.not_required: No constant maximal density, no compulsory chaos in every section

curiosity.meaning: Neugier explores; Kuriosität creates unusual relations within current Dark Psychedelic identity
examples: drop changes the meaning of its preparation
curiosity.boundary: Unusual does not justify unrelated genre drift or arbitrary novelty. Current meaning determines whether an oddity belongs.

direction.meaning: Shared musical purpose, not uniformity or mandatory linear order

psychoacoustics.role: Cross-cutting perceptual relationship affecting all musical possibilities, not just an FX family or new controller
examples: briefly reduce competing mids to expose a voice
move upper textures across stereo field while keeping LOW anchored
withdraw selected layers before a focal event
use dry/wet and spectral contrast for apparent proximity
psychoacoustics.limits: Stereo playback does not guarantee literal rear localization; actual perception depends on rendered signal, playback and listener. No claim of DSP or Suno execution. Preserve mono sub, kick transients, intelligibility and mixability.

relation_policy: Meaning selects relevant possibilities; causal relationships may mutually reinforce, inhibit, redirect or transform them.
